import importlib.util,json
from pathlib import Path
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('existing_vm_harness','/srv/forge-apps-build/sources/forgeos-task4-committed/tools/qemu_daily_vm.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
expected=json.loads(Path('/srv/forge-apps-fast/lab/apps-v12-final/run-ba8c3b8f770240cea047dbd8c19b8d4f/started.json').read_text())['command']
original=m.qemu_command
def reviewed_command(*args,**kwargs):
 command=original(*args,**kwargs)
 i=command.index('-netdev')+1
 assert command[i]=='user,id=net0'
 command[i]=expected[expected.index('-netdev')+1]
 def normalized(c):
  c=c.copy()
  c[c.index('-serial')+1]='SERIAL'
  c[c.index('-qmp')+1]='QMP'
  return c
 assert normalized(command)==normalized(expected),(command,expected)
 return command
m.qemu_command=reviewed_command
def reviewed_chain(instance,metadata,image_tool='qemu-img'):
 import subprocess
 assert metadata['instance_id']=='d37397c7-dcee-4d83-b6d2-3b7628de1cba'
 assert metadata['base_size']==21474836480
 assert metadata['base_sha256']=='59715e4b286d40d4597f7dadca3d2866b4d836608568c06e6b88d67f5ab546ca'
 result=subprocess.run([image_tool,'info','--output=json','--backing-chain',str(instance/'disk.qcow2')],check=True,text=True,capture_output=True)
 assert len(result.stdout)<=65536
 chain=json.loads(result.stdout)
 assert isinstance(chain,list) and len(chain)==2 and all(isinstance(x,dict) for x in chain)
 overlay,base=chain
 assert overlay.get('filename')==str(instance/'disk.qcow2')
 assert overlay.get('format')=='qcow2'
 assert overlay.get('full-backing-filename')==metadata['base'] and overlay.get('backing-filename')==metadata['base']
 assert overlay.get('backing-filename-format')=='raw'
 assert overlay.get('virtual-size')==42949672960
 assert base.get('format')=='raw' and base.get('filename')==metadata['base']
 assert base.get('virtual-size')==metadata['base_size'] and 'backing-filename' not in base
 assert not overlay.get('format-specific',{}).get('data',{}).get('corrupt',False)
 print('CAPACITY_RESUME_VALIDATED overlay=42949672960 base=21474836480 approved=2026-09-30-rolling-capacity.json',flush=True)
 return chain
m.inspect_chain=reviewed_chain
m.start_instance(Path('/srv/forge-apps-fast/lab/apps-v12-final'),cpus=2,accelerator='kvm',audio='none')
